changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders. rank_analysis left empty, to be filled by the data managers. Genotype spellings merged:  Peka 6 -> Peka 6;  RWASOY 20-1 -> RWASOY 20-1;  RWASOY 20-2 -> RWASOY 20-2;  RWASOY 20-3 -> RWASOY 20-3;  RWASOY 20-4 -> RWASOY 20-4;  RWASOY 20-5 -> RWASOY 20-5;  RWASOY 20-6 -> RWASOY 20-6;  RWASOY 20-7 -> RWASOY 20-7;  RWASOY 20-8 -> RWASOY 20-8;  SC Saga -> SC Saga;  SC Squire -> SC Squire;  TGX 1987- 62F -> TGX 1987- 62F;  TGX 2001-20DM -> TGX 2001-20DM;  TGX 2014-19FM -> TGX 2014-19FM;  Tikolore -> Tikolore

study.title: 22B Soybeans varieties
study.description: On-farm trials implemented under the scope of 1000FARMS project to introduce new varieties in the Rwanda seed systems.

location_privacy.method: Each site displaced to a random point within a fixed radius, reproducible per site id. Sites published in release v1 keep their v1 coordinates.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised

funder.5: We recevied this grant as sub-grantees of the main grant given to Bioversity-CIAT alliance

variables.description: Site identifier, trial id plus package number
Trial identifier. ClimMob v3 project id, or for legacy trials 11 hex characters plus 'v' (see decisions)
Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code
Country name
Crop tested in the trial
Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), displaced to protect participants
Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), displaced to protect participants
Where the original coordinate was taken (farm, adm3 mean of other sites, missing, removed)
Radius in metres around the published point that contains the original point (displacement plus spread of the sites used for gap filling)
Check of the original coordinate against the country boundary (ok, near_border, missing, outside, swapped_candidate, sign_flip_candidate)
Lowest administrative unit recorded (village, community, kebele)
First level administrative unit (state, province, region, department)
AEZ for this cell
Planting date (YYYY-MM-DD)
Did the trial continue until this time?

variables.description: Does farmer still have enough grains of the 3 varieties to enable comparison?

variables.description: Site identifier, links to site_data
Plot letter within the site (A, B, C)
Name of the genotype (variety) in the plot

Identifier of the harmonised question
Question code or label as used in the trial
Value. For value_type rank, 1 is best and 3 is worst
rank, vs_local, numeric, date, categorical, multiple or text
Unit of numeric values. Yield values refer to the entire plot
Quality flag (implausible_yield_per_area, outlier_vs_trial_median, unit_unclear, derived)
